evidence: Integrity: all 35 task files in manifest.json inputs.task re-hash to the recorded SHA256 in the frozen cache; all 6 raw-evidence-index entries re-hash correctly (not relevant runtime evidence for this source-only row). Note: the frozen root workbook 'WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx' (6d44970b...) differs in bytes from the skill's bundled assets/WebDev_Rubrics_QC.xlsx (d7b5d607...); row 5 text is identical in both Quality and Internal sheets of the root workbook, so this does not affect this row. Procedure per quality-checks.md:25-27. (1) Vocabulary grep, case-insensitive, over the agent-visible prompt surfaces instruction.md and environment/instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md} for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|gate|probe|verifier|grader|grading|oracle|harness|mcp|polish|visual|functional|render|constraint: zero hits. The brief never names the judge, the claude-code/GLM model, Playwright, the functional/polish/visual dimensions, the 0.6/0.2/0.2 weights or the functional floor (tests/scoring.toml), the render/constraints gates, any /tests path, score.py or restart_mcp.py. (2) Criterion ids: 55 criteria parsed from the 5 judge.toml files (1+1+43+5+5); none of their ids (hro_* etc.) occurs in the public text. (3) Probe/sentinel literals: every quoted/backticked/code-shaped literal in tests/**/*.md and *.toml was intersected with the public text; the only overlaps are the ten demo account emails and the password Hireops!2026, which are required runtime contract (instruction.md:17) and are expected to agree with the judge sign-ins (check-demo-accounts-agree.py), not grader sentinels. The judge's evaluator-limitation phrase 'NOT EXERCISED — evaluator/tool limitation' and polish example 'Call back on Fri' do not appear in the brief or notes. The seeded note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' appears only in environment/assets/seed_data.json:1024 as product data, not in any prompt text. (4) Verbatim overlap: longest common word run between any criterion description and the public text is 10 words (hro_bulk_move: 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order', which is the public rule at hireops_rules.md:90 restated by the criterion); only 2 criteria share an 8-gram and 3 a 7-gram, all restating product rules (refused move put back with focus, bulk-move ordering, 30-message page). No judge prompt.md or app_context.md shares any 10-gram with the public text. This is criteria quoting requirements, not the brief reproducing grading text. (5) Grader-shaped phrasing check: hireops_rules.md states HTTP statuses (401/403/404/409), the 15-second freshness bound and the 30-message page; these are product behaviour requirements, not grader instructions. The instructions say what the product must do, never how it will be checked. Adversarial attempts: (a) Broken app that could pass because of a leak: I looked for a named probe value, route, element id or sentinel the brief exposes that would let a stub hard-code the graded observable; none exists, and the rules explicitly leave routes, field names, element ids and labels to the builder (hireops_rules.md:3-5). (b) Conforming alternative that could fail: not applicable to this row, which concerns disclosure, not grading strictness. What the task does well: the brief reads as a product request with all rubric vocabulary absent, and the operational facts are in plain product language.
